name: Alternating gym transformation montage
description: Eight source-timed gym shots alternate the same identity between before and after states across matched exercise setups.
lockedGrammar: One identity lineage across all before and after states
Before and after alternate on four gym setup families
Exact hard cuts at seven measured boundaries
After-state reaction caption appears on three intervals
Observable face and body morphology change together
Real-time exercise motion and flat gym lighting

variables.description: One fictional or authorized person used across all eight takes.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional adult with a consistent face, hairline and underlying facial geometry
examples: a blonde woman with a chin-length bob
a Black man with short curls

variables.description: Observable opening-state face/body morphology without medical estimates.
variables.defaultValue: fuller cheeks and lower face, softer jaw and chin-to-neck transition, fuller arms and torso, natural garment tension and seated compression
leaner cheeks and jaw contours, slimmer arms and torso, athletic posture
plain black gymwear and small white earbuds
green and neutral gymwear with white headphones

variables.description: Exact short reaction caption on the first three after reveals.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation in {{before_state}}, seated on a hip-adduction machine wearing {{before_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform a controlled seated hip-adduction repetition at real-time speed; preserve {{subject_identity}} and {{before_state}}.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{after_state}}, seated on the matched leg machine wearing {{after_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Turn smoothly from profile toward camera with a knowing relaxed expression; preserve identity and {{after_state}}.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{before_state}} at an overhead press machine wearing {{before_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Press both handles upward and lower them with believable resistance at real-time speed.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{after_state}} at the matched overhead press machine wearing {{after_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform one smooth shoulder-press phase and briefly smile; preserve identity and equipment geometry.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{before_state}}, side profile on a treadmill wearing {{before_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Walk at a steady natural real-time pace with moving belt and subtle arm and hair motion.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{after_state}}, side profile on the matched treadmill wearing {{after_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Walk at the same steady real-time pace with matched step rhythm and subtle secondary motion.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: A very low treadmill-console view of the same {{subject_identity}} in {{before_state}}, wearing {{before_wardrobe}} and looking downward.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Continue walking with subtle vertical rhythm and hair motion, holding a neutral downward gaze.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The matched very low view of the same {{subject_identity}} in {{after_state}}, wearing {{after_wardrobe}}.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Continue walking, then smile warmly down at the lens; preserve the exact identity and {{after_state}}.

deterministicLayers.template: Apply {{audio_policy}} across all exact hard cuts.

promptExamples: Use the alternating transformation montage with a blonde woman, black before outfits, green after outfits, and GymLevels reaction captions.

notes: Analysis-v9 repair raised before-state facial fidelity from 3/10 to 9/10 and body-state fidelity from 4/10 to 9/10.
Identity continuity scored 9/10; all seven hard-cut timestamps were preserved.
